assignments.name: buyers
assignments.value: Heads of Sales, Sales Ops, RevOps, SDR managers and founders at B2B software companies of 51 to 500 employees with a sales team of 5 or more. Not a fit: engineering, design, support and finance roles.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ limit: Number($json.limit) || 50, properties: ["firstname", "lastname", "email", "jobtitle", "company", "website", "hs_linkedin_url", "job_function", "hs_seniority"], filterGroups: ['email', 'jobtitle'].map(p => ({ filters: [{ propertyName: p, operator: 'NOT_HAS_PROPERTY' }, { propertyName: 'ai_enrichment_status', operator: 'NOT_HAS_PROPERTY' }, { propertyName: 'createdate', operator: 'GTE', value: String(Date.now() - Number($json.since_days || 7) * 86400000) }]})) }) }}

parameters.text: ={{ JSON.stringify($input.all().map(i => ({ id: i.json.id, name: (i.json.crm.firstname + ' ' + i.json.crm.lastname).trim(), company: i.json.crm.company, crm_title: i.json.crm.jobtitle, title: i.json.found.title || '', employees: i.json.found.employees || '', industry: i.json.found.industry || '', growth_1y_pct: i.json.found.growth_1y_pct, months_in_role: i.json.found.months_in_role, email_status: i.json.found.email_status || 'not found' }))) }}

options.systemMessage:
=You review contacts that an enrichment step just completed. For each contact in the JSON (CRM fields plus what Evaboot found: title, company size, industry, growth, months in role, email status), return a job function, a seniority and a fit against the buyers below, and one summary line. Use only these facts; never invent anything.

Return {contacts: [{id, job_function, seniority, fit, summary}]}:
- job_function: a short department name (Sales, Marketing, Engineering...), only when a title is known, else "".
- seniority: one of owner, partner, executive, vp, director, manager, senior, entry, employee, only when a title is known, else "".
- fit: good, maybe or no. A row whose name is not a person (a team or company page) is no.
- summary: one line under 30 words on who they are and why they fit or not. When no title was found, say so.
- Never guess anyone's gender: no he, she, him or her. Use the first name, "they" or the role.

Buyers:
{{ $('Settings').first().json.buyers }}
